items.title: UnitedHealth Sinks 5% on Medicare Advantage Audit Plan as CMS Moves to “Crush” Medical Fraud
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth fell 5% after CMS proposed clawing back Medicare Advantage overpayments as far back as payment year 2018, and Humana and CVS Health fell too. CMS estimates the audits would recover about $9 billion per payment year industry-wide, and UnitedHealth hasn’t sized its share.
